answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, which leverage verifiable delay functions to harbor a cryptographically secure plume of identity attestations, thereby preventing malicious agents from launching echo chambers of cloned identities; assuming computational hardness of collision-resistant hashing, we prove that forging a duplicate reputation tag requires solving a sequential delay function, rendering identity spoofing computationally infeasible and guaranteeing information-theoretic unforgeability.
